title: ZAOstock Round 3 - Anything But A Poster
description:
ANYTHING BUT A POSTER. Make one piece of media for ZAOstock that is not a still image with type on it. Post it publicly, claim it here. Closes 5pm Eastern Wednesday September 23.

WHY THE BAN. Round one was five posters out of six. They were good. The kit makes a poster easy, which is why nearly everyone made one, and a feed full of the same rectangle stops working. Round two asked for video and got five out of eight, so you have already proved you can do it. Today the poster is off the table entirely and the question is what you would make instead.

MAKE SOMETHING ONLY YOU WOULD MAKE. This is the whole ask. Not the best-executed version of the obvious idea, the thing that comes out of what you are actually good at. Some of what that could be:
1. Fifteen seconds that moves, with sound.
2. A jingle, a beat, a song, a thirty-second radio-style spot in your own voice.
3. A meme, a reaction edit, a shitpost that is genuinely funny and still carries the date.
4. A photo of something physical you put up in a real place, with the place visible.
5. A comic, a strip, an animated loop, a sticker sheet, a zine page.
6. Something in a format nobody on this list thought of.

A poster does not count today. A still frame exported from something that moves does not count either. If it does not move, make a sound, or exist in the physical world, it is probably a poster.

ALSO ACCEPTED TODAY: MAKE SOMETHING WE ALREADY RUN BETTER. Not promo at all. If you would rather fix than advertise, fix, and claim that instead.
1. The festival site, https://zaostock.com - the code is at https://github.com/ZAODEVZ/ZAOstock and issues are open. A page that is missing, something broken on a phone, a real design pass.
2. poidhz.com, where these bounties and everybody's feedback live: https://github.com/bettercallzaal/poidhz
3. The ZAOstock or ZAO Festivals brand itself - something the kit does not have and should. A missing asset, a template, a type or colour fix.

HOW TO SUBMIT A FIX. A pull request, an issue with a real mockup, or a design file all count. Put the link in your claim.

THE BAR BELOW IS WRITTEN FOR MEDIA. If you are on this track, rules 1, 2, 5 and 6 apply and rules 3, 4 and 7 do not - it has to be reachable, claimed here, on-brand and not slop, but do not put the festival date on a website fix.

WANT MY VOICE ON IT? If your piece needs 30 to 60 seconds of me saying something, tag me on Farcaster with the script and send me your Telegram in a DM - I send the voice note there, so do not post your handle in the open. If there is time before the close I will record it and get it back to you.

ZAOstock is a free music festival on Saturday October 3, 2026, in Ellsworth, Maine. Franklin Street closes to traffic and eight independent acts play back to back on the parklet stage from noon to six. Free, all ages, rain or shine. Everything you need is at https://zaostock.com - read it before you make anything. 10 days out.

THE BAR. Requirements, not preferences. Miss one and it is not entered.
1. UPLOAD THE PIECE, AND SHARE A LINK TO WHERE YOU UPLOADED IT. Both. Upload it here, and put a direct link to the file in your description so it plays for anyone who opens the claim. Then open your own claim and click that link. In round two, four of the eight claims were a screenshot of a post rather than the piece, and one linked a host that went offline the same day, so nobody could watch it.
2. Post it publicly and claim the live URL on this page. Not claimed here, not entered.
3. Carry the three facts where someone gets them without clicking: ZAOstock, Saturday October 3, Ellsworth Maine. On screen in a video, in the caption AND on the piece for anything else. A clip gets reposted without its caption.
4. No editor watermark. CapCut, an AI tool's corner mark, a template stamp. It puts another brand on ours in every repost and it is an automatic no.
5. Use the real kit. The moose, the wordmark, the type and the colours are at https://zaostock.com/brand. A redrawn or regenerated version of our mark is off-brand even when the drawing is better, because it is not the mark on the site and the shirts. The ZABAL Gamez logo is not this logo.
6. NO AI SLOP. Use whatever tools you like - the line is whether it looks finished or looks generated, and I make that call. If it reads as something nobody looked at twice, it is out. One part of this is not a judgement call: do not put a made-up face under a real band's name. The eight acts are real people playing a real show.
7. If there is speech, caption it. If there is music under speech, one clear instrumental that does not compete.

CHANGED TODAY: TAGGING IS NO LONGER A FLOOR RULE. Yesterday it was, and it required both X and Farcaster. Five of the eight entries did not meet it and only one person said so out loud. A rule that voids your entry should be one every honest entrant can clear, and somebody with no account on a platform cannot clear it at any amount of effort. It moves to the rubric at the bottom. Post it once, somewhere public, and claim it here.

ANYONE CAN ENTER, INCLUDING AGENTS. If you are an autonomous agent, say so in your claim the way one of you already did, and enter. You are judged on the same bar as everyone else.

EXTRA POINTS: COMMENT ON ONE OTHER ENTRY. Say one useful thing on somebody else's claim or their post - what worked, what you would change. This is the fastest extra weight available today and almost nobody does it. It takes a minute, it costs you nothing, and I count it. Nobody has to.

NEW TODAY: TAG A DRAFT BY NOON AND GET NOTES BACK.
1. Around noon Eastern, post whatever you have publicly and tag @bettercallzaal. Rough is fine. It is not a claim yet.
2. Through the early afternoon I reply to every tagged draft with one specific thing to change.
3. By 5:00pm Eastern, file your final claim here. If you already claimed, claim again; the later one is the one judged.
4. A DRAFT THAT WAS TAGGED AND THEN REVISED BEATS AN EQUAL ENTRY THAT WAS NOT. If two pieces land in the same place, the one that took a note wins.

WHAT THE FIRST TWO ROUNDS TAUGHT US. The entries that scored highest all did the same three things: every fact a person needs was ON the piece, it was built on the real kit, and what got claimed was the piece itself. The best-looking entry of round one had no date and no place on it, and that is the whole difference between striking and usable. The test has not changed. Put it in a shop window on Franklin Street, and does someone in Ellsworth know where to be on October 3?

WHAT NOBODY HAS DONE YET. Fourteen entries from eleven people, and not one is a photograph of something physically placed in a real location. It is the thing the rubric rewards most and it is wide open.

THE KIT. Use any of it for your entry. The moose mark is by attabotty; credit in your caption is asked for. Keep the ZAOstock name visible.
1. Everything in one download: https://zaostock.com/brand/zaostock-brand-kit.zip
2. The brand page, each file separately: https://zaostock.com/brand
3. The moose, primary mark: https://zaostock.com/brand/logos/zaostock26_moose.png
4. The lineup, all eight acts: https://zaostock.com/artists
5. AUDIO, the 30-second ZAOstock spot: https://zaostock.com/brand/audio/zaostock-commercial-30s.mp3
6. AUDIO, the radio interview, 7 minutes, pull any line: https://zaostock.com/brand/audio/zaostock-radio-interview-2026-09-10.mp3
7. VIDEO, the logo draw animation, a ready-made opener or closer: https://zaostock.com/brand/video/logo-draw-animation.mp4

THE REWARD. Winner takes the whole pot. This is an OPEN bounty: the pot is whatever this page says right now and it grows as others contribute. Read the number at the top of the page, not a number in this text. Every submitter is added to the POIDH Submitters leaderboard on Empire Builder, which is how $ZABAL has been distributed to this programme's entrants: https://www.empirebuilder.world/empire/0xbb48f19b0494ff7c1fe5dc2032aeee14312f0b07

This bounty promises the pot and nothing else. We might run the best entries on ZAOstock's channels and we would like to, but it is not written here as a commitment. This programme has a record of making publication promises it did not keep, and you can read that record at https://poidhz.com/about

HOW THE WINNERS ARE PICKED, AND WHERE YOUR NOTES GO. I review ROUND TWO AND ROUND THREE TOGETHER later today and post both results at the same time. I said I would name the round two pick on stream and I did not, so I am not promising a stream again - I post it on Firefly, everywhere at once, with the link.

Everyone who enters gets written notes on their own piece, win or lose. One thing it did and one thing to do better. They all go up at https://poidhz.com/feedback - every entrant gets their own page, and they are public so you can read what was asked of everybody else and not only of you. Round one's are up there now.

Then everyone who added to a pot has two days to vote on that pick before it pays out. The people who paid for it get a say. Discord: https://discord.thezao.com

THE RUBRIC, LIGHT. Not a formula, this is honestly how I weigh it.
1. Clears the bar above. Miss one and nothing else counts.
2. It moves, makes a sound, or exists somewhere real. That is the whole ask today.
3. The facts are ON the piece, not only in your caption. This decides more rounds than anything else.
4. It went where people who could actually attend will see it. Ellsworth, Bangor, Downeast. A flyer photographed on a real wall beats a post nobody saw.
5. You tagged a draft around noon and changed something after my note.
6. You said something useful on somebody else's entry.
7. Tagged @bettercallzaal and cross-posted in /poidh. Both beats one, one beats neither, none of it voids you.
8. It looks finished. Vertical or square, spelling right, the eight names right.
9. It is specific and honest about the day: small, free, outdoors, one street.
10. If you fixed something instead of promoting something: would we actually ship it.

Submissions close 5:00pm Eastern, Wednesday September 23, 2026. Drafts tagged around noon get notes back. ZAOstock is Saturday October 3. Promo that lands after it is worth nothing, which is why these close fast. The festival: https://zaostock.com

description:

THE TASK

title: open a museum for one ordinary thing 🏛️
description:
Pick one ordinary thing you own. A spoon, a charger, a sock that lost its twin. Give it the museum treatment.

**Build it an exhibit**
- something to stand on: a book, a box, an upturned mug
- some light, if you have it
- a label card beside it, handwritten or printed, with a title, a date (a guess is fine), the materials, and a curator's note of three sentences at most that takes the thing far too seriously

Then photograph the whole exhibit in one frame: object, plinth and label, with the label readable.

**Rules**
- A real object and a photo you took. No AI images, no mockups.
- One claim per person.
- Claims close at the end of 30 September (UTC). I pick one winner after that and pay out the bounty.

**What wins**
The curator's note I'm still thinking about a day later. Good light helps. A funny object helps more.

An example label, for the tone:

*Untitled (Lid), c. 2019. Polypropylene.*
*Parted from its container during a move and never reunited. Kept "in case." It has since outlived three containers it did not fit.*

![The Museum of One Thing](https://files.catbox.moe/fkj8ny.png)

title: ZAOstock Round 4 - Make An Ad, 30 Seconds Or Less
description:
MAKE AN AD FOR ZAOSTOCK. Thirty seconds or less. Any format you like. Post it publicly, claim it here. Closes 5:00pm Eastern, Sunday September 27.

ZAOstock is a free music festival on Saturday October 3, 2026, in Ellsworth, Maine. Franklin Street closes to traffic, one stage goes up in the Franklin Street Parklet, and eight acts play from noon to six. Free. All ages. Rain or shine.

WHY AN AD, AND WHY THIRTY SECONDS

Three rounds in, nineteen entries, and the pieces that worked were the ones that made a stranger want to be there. That is an advert. So this round says the word out loud instead of dancing around it.

Thirty seconds is the only hard constraint, and it is there because it forces you to choose. Most entries so far have tried to carry the whole festival - eight acts, the street, the times, the after-party. An advert picks one thing and lands it. If your piece does not move, thirty seconds does not apply to you, but the same rule does: it has to work in the three seconds someone looks at it before scrolling.

THE BAR

1. IF IT IS A STILL, UPLOAD THE FILE ITSELF. IF IT IS VIDEO OR AUDIO, UPLOAD ONE FRAME AND PUT THE LINK IN YOUR DESCRIPTION. poidh puts every upload on IPFS, so the uploader takes images and not video - that is the platform, not a preference of mine. Kenny confirmed it this week. A screenshot of your post is still the weakest thing you can file, because it shows your post instead of your work. A frame from the piece is better. The link is what I actually watch.

2. POST IT PUBLICLY AND CLAIM IT HERE with the live URL. If it is not claimed on this page, it is not entered.

3. THIRTY SECONDS OR LESS if it moves. There is no minimum.

4. THE FACTS GO ON THE PIECE, NOT ONLY IN YOUR CAPTION. A repost strips your caption. At minimum: ZAOstock, Saturday October 3, Ellsworth Maine, and the word FREE. Three separate entrants across the last two rounds left FREE off, and it is the single fact that turns someone who is curious into someone who turns up.

5. NO EDITOR WATERMARK. A CapCut corner, an AI tool's stamp, a template mark. It puts another brand on ours in every repost.

THE FULL FACT SET, IF YOU WANT IT ALL

ZAOstock 2026. Saturday October 3. Franklin Street Parklet, downtown Ellsworth, Maine. Noon to six. Free, all ages, rain or shine. One street, one stage, eight acts: The Crown Vics, OPEN X, Grass Rug, Acadia Rising, Michael Anderson, DCoop, LyonsDen and Tom Fellenz. Afterwards there is a party at Black Moon Public House next door with a DJ, from six.

Everything above is published at https://zaostock.com and https://zaostock.com/artists. If you state a fact that is not on that site, you are guessing, and I would rather you left it out.

THE KIT - USE ANY OF THIS FOR YOUR ENTRY

Everything in one download: https://zaostock.com/brand/zaostock-brand-kit.zip

The brand page, each file on its own: https://zaostock.com/brand

The moose, primary mark: https://zaostock.com/brand/logos/zaostock26_moose.png

The lineup, all eight acts: https://zaostock.com/artists

The moose mark is by attabotty. Credit in your caption is asked for. There is also a radio interview in the kit. It is the most useful thing in there and it is barely touched.

ANYONE CAN ENTER, INCLUDING AGENTS

If you are an autonomous agent, you are eligible and you are judged on the same bar as everyone else. Say so in your claim - the one agent that has entered these rounds declared itself every time, unprompted, and that is the standard.

A separate bounty for agents only is coming, running to the day of the festival, with unlimited resubmissions. It is not cast yet, so nothing about it is a commitment and nobody is being asked to wait for it.

WANT MY VOICE ON IT?

If your piece needs thirty to sixty seconds of me saying something, tag me on Farcaster with the script and send me your Telegram in a direct message - I send the voice note there, so do not post your handle in the open. If there is time before the close I will record it. Nobody took this up last round and the offer stands.

THE RUBRIC

Light on purpose, in the order that actually decides it:

1. Would this make someone in Maine who has never heard of ZAOstock turn up? That is the whole job.
2. Are the facts on the piece, and are they right?
3. Did you make something only you could have made, rather than the obvious idea done neatly?
4. Does it hold up muted, and does it hold up as a single screenshot?
5. Is it finished - no watermark, no stray cursor, no placeholder.

EXTRA POINTS, NOT REQUIREMENTS

Shoot or record something real rather than generating it. Put it somewhere people who can actually attend will see it - Ellsworth, Bangor, Downeast Maine. Credit attabotty. Tell me something that would improve the website, the ZAOstock brand, or how these bounties run - the last three rounds each changed because somebody said something.

THE REWARD

Winner takes the whole pot. This is an OPEN bounty, so the pot is whatever this page says it is right now, and anyone can add to it while the round runs. Round three's pot grew while it was open.

Every submitter is added to the POIDH Submitters leaderboard on Empire Builder, which is how $ZABAL has been distributed to this programme's entrants. On September 23 that went out to all 43 addresses on the feed in a single transaction, scaled by score, with nobody missed.

Track it: https://www.empirebuilder.world/empire/0xbb48f19b0494ff7c1fe5dc2032aeee14312f0b07

This bounty promises the pot and nothing else. We might run the best entries on ZAOstock's channels and we would like to, but it is not written here as a commitment. This programme has a record of making publication promises it did not keep, and you can read that record at https://poidhz.com/about

EVERYONE WHO ENTERS GETS WRITTEN NOTES

One thing your piece did and one thing to do better. Win or lose. They go up at https://poidhz.com/feedback - every entrant gets their own page, tied to the bounty so it is never overwritten, and they are public so you can read what was asked of everybody else and not only of you. Fifteen pages are up there now, covering all three rounds so far.

No ranking is ever published on those pages. You will not find out you came second.

HOW THE WINNER IS PICKED

I review every entry after the close and post the pick next week, during the week, on Firefly, everywhere at once, with the link. I am not naming a day, because this programme has twice named one and missed it, and I would rather say something true than something tidy.

Submissions close 5:00pm Eastern, Sunday September 27, 2026. ZAOstock is Saturday October 3. Promo that lands after it is worth nothing, which is why these close fast. The festival: https://zaostock.com

title: best poidh AI cartoon story 🎬
description:
Create an **AI-generated cartoon ad for poidh** in the style of the references below.

We’re looking for the kind of AI song ad that’s been making the rounds lately: **story-driven, character-based, music-forward, funny/memorable, and built around an actual narrative arc.**

Think:

* strong opening hook
* recurring characters
* catchy song / jingle
* multiple scenes that build on each other
* clear beginning, middle, and end
* humor, absurdity, charm, or a strong payoff
* something people would actually want to watch and share

This is **not** a quick promo clip, slideshow, generic explainer, or collection of disconnected AI scenes.

### References

**Kalshi ad:**
https://x.com/brianjpempus/status/2103199211202445813

**Overview + examples of the style:**
https://starpop.ai/blog/articles/ai-song-ad-examples

### Requirements

* Must be an **original AI-generated cartoon ad for poidh**
* **1 minute minimum**
* **1:30–5:00** is the ideal range
* Must have an actual **story arc**
* Should use music / a song as a meaningful part of the ad
* Characters and visuals should feel reasonably consistent from scene to scene
* Should feel distinctly **poidh**, not like a generic ad with our name pasted onto it

### How to enter

1. Post your finished video on **X or Farcaster**
2. Tag **@kennyistyping** on X or **@kenny** on Farcaster in the post
3. Submit a claim on this bounty using a **screenshot from the video**
4. Include a **link to your X/Farcaster post in the claim description**

### Winner

The **best video, as judged by bounty contributors, takes the 🏆**

We’ll be looking at the overall concept, story, characters, music, humor, execution, polish, and how memorable/shareable the finished ad is.

### Deadline

**Wednesday, September 30th at 11:59pm PST**

title: ZAOstock Round 5 - Ship Code, Not A Poster
description:
SHIP CODE, NOT A POSTER. Open a pull request against the ZAOstock repository that makes the site visibly better, or makes the repository itself better to work in. Claim it here with the link to your PR. Closes 5:00pm Eastern, Monday October 5.

THIS ONE IS WRITTEN FOR AGENTS.

Every round so far has asked for media. This one asks for code, because an autonomous agent that can read a codebase, find something wrong and fix it properly is doing the thing this programme actually wants to pay for. If you are an agent, say so in your claim. If you are a human, you are welcome and you are judged on the same bar - the brief is just aimed somewhere else this time.

THE REPO

https://github.com/ZAODEVZ/ZAOstock

Public, MIT licensed, TypeScript and Next.js. It is the real site at zaostock.com, not a sandbox.

YOU DO NOT NEED ANY CREDENTIALS. Clone it, npm ci, and then npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test and npm run build all work with no secrets at all. That is exactly what CI runs on your pull request. Only running the dev server against live data wants a database key, and most changes do not need one.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. It has the real workflow rather than boilerplate. Then docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

WHAT COUNTS

An OPEN pull request counts as a complete entry. It does not have to be merged to win.

That is deliberate. If merging were the bar, then whether you can win would depend on how fast I review, and I am not going to put a prize behind my own inbox. If two entries are close, the one that got merged wins the tie.

What I am looking for, in the order it matters:

1. IT MAKES THE SITE BETTER TO USE. Somebody lands on a phone, on cell service, trying to find out when a band plays. Anything that makes that person's experience better is the top of this list. A page that works on a phone when it did not. A page that loads before they give up. Something readable in sunlight.

2. A NEW IDEA THAT CAN SHIP IN UNDER A WEEK. Not only fixes. If you can see something this site should have and you can build it before this round closes, build it. Small and finished beats big and half done, and a working idea nobody asked for is the most valuable thing anybody can bring me.

3. IT IS REAL WORK ON A REAL CODEBASE. Read the code, find something actually wrong, fix that. Do not open a PR that renames variables and calls it a refactor.

4. IT PASSES CI. typecheck, lint, test, build. Run them before you push - the repo tells you how.

5. IT EXPLAINS ITSELF. The PR description should say what was wrong, how you know, and what you changed. If you measured something, show the measurement. "Improved performance" is not a claim, it is a mood.

6. IT IS SCOPED. One clear change, reviewable in one sitting.

THE MORE YOU DO, THE MORE CHANCES YOU GET, AND THAT IS LITERAL

Every pull request is its own claim and every claim is another entry. Five small good ones beat one enormous one. There is no cap and no penalty for trying something that does not land.

ASK ME THINGS. IT COUNTS IN YOUR FAVOUR, NOT AGAINST YOU.

Tag me with a draft, a question, or a half-finished idea and ask whether it is worth doing. I answer WHILE THE ROUND IS STILL RUNNING, not after it, because an answer that arrives once you can no longer act on it is worth nothing. There is a box on the submission page for exactly this.

I am not naming a turnaround. This programme has broken enough timing promises to know better, and that is written down. What I will say is that this round runs ten days on purpose, and an entrant who asks, gets an answer, goes away and comes back with it improved is doing exactly what I want to pay for. I weigh that.

Your written notes still come after the close, like every round. The answering is the extra.

Asking is not a sign you are stuck. It is the loop working. Come back twice and you are ahead of someone who submitted once and vanished.

SOME THINGS THAT WOULD GENUINELY HELP

Not a list to work through, and not exhaustive - if you find something better, do that instead.

The site is a festival site and the festival is October 3. Anything that makes it clearer on a phone, faster to load, or easier to read in sunlight is worth more than anything clever. The home page pulls about three megabytes, and a single autoplaying video is more than half of that, on a page people open on cell service standing in a street. Bring the before and after numbers if you go at it. "Improved performance" is not a claim, it is a mood.

Look hard at the checks themselves. One of them was reporting PASS after reading zero files until somebody went and read it, and a check that cannot fail is worth more to fix than a feature. If you touch one, prove it with a control: plant the thing it must catch, watch it fail, take it out, watch it pass. A green check nobody has tested is a rumour.

Running lint prints warnings and still exits zero, so nothing stops one more landing. There is one end-to-end test for forty pages.

The repository is carrying more than two hundred branches and the large majority of them belong to pull requests that were merged long ago. Nobody can tell what is live. That one is mine to fix, not yours, but it tells you what kind of mess is in here.

Accessibility. Contrast, focus states, alt text, keyboard navigation, heading order. Almost nobody does this work and it is the kind that stays done.

The documentation in docs/ is extensive and some of it is stale. A PR that deletes something no longer true is worth as much as one that adds something.

HOW TO CLAIM

Open the pull request. Then go to https://poidhz.com/submit, fill it in, and it gives you a receipt card with your PR link, your handle and your agent declaration on it. THAT CARD IS YOUR CLAIM IMAGE. Upload it here and paste your PR link in the description.

poidh needs an image on every claim and a code entry has nothing to photograph, so the image is the receipt instead of a tax. The page stores nothing, asks for no login and has no database. It draws a picture from what you type.

IF YOU ARE AN AGENT WITH NO BROWSER, YOU DO NOT NEED THAT PAGE. The same card is served as an image you can fetch directly:

https://poidhz.com/api/receipt?round=5&pr=YOUR_PR_URL&who=YOUR_HANDLE&agent=1

Stateless, no auth, CORS open, returns an SVG. Convert it or upload it as you like. If you claim through the contract rather than the web form, point your claim uri at https://poidhz.com/api/claim-meta with that as the image and skip uploading altogether. Fetching either URL enters you into nothing. The claim is the entry.

Claim as many times as you like, one claim per pull request. Unlike the last round, a later claim does not replace an earlier one here; they all count together.

IF YOU ARE AN AGENT, SAY SO

Declare it in the claim. One agent has entered these rounds before and declared itself every time, unprompted, including the one rule it could not meet. That is the standard and it did that agent no harm at all.

WHAT THIS PROGRAMME HAS AND HAS NOT DELIVERED is written down at https://poidhz.com/about and you should read it before you trust any of this.

EVERYONE WHO ENTERS GETS WRITTEN NOTES

One thing your work did and one thing to do better, win or lose. They go up at https://poidhz.com/feedback - every entrant gets their own page, tied to the bounty so it is never overwritten, and they are public so you can read what was asked of everybody else. Nineteen pages are up there now across three rounds. That promise has been kept every round it was made.

No ranking is ever published on those pages.

HOW THE WINNER IS PICKED

I read every pull request after the close and pick the one that did the most valuable thing for this repository. I post it that week, on Firefly, with the link.

Submissions close 5:00pm Eastern, Monday October 5, 2026. That is two days after the festival, on purpose - the site outlives the event and the repo is what carries it to the next one.

title: ZAOstock Round 7 - Run A Bounty For ZAOstock
description:
RUN A BOUNTY FOR ZAOSTOCK.

Create your own bounty on poidh about ZAOstock or ZAO Festivals, run it well, and claim here with its link. The best-run bounty wins this one. We are looking for people who can write a bounty AND run it, because that is who we want making bounties for The ZAO next.

ZAOstock is a free music festival on Saturday October 3, 2026, in Ellsworth, Maine. Franklin Street closes to traffic and eight independent acts play back to back on the parklet stage from noon to six. Free, all ages, rain or shine. It streams live at https://zaostock.com/live.


WHY THIS ROUND EXISTS

A good bounty that someone else writes reaches their people, not just ours. We want to find the people who can do that well, and writing one is only half of it. The other half is running it: answering people, picking fairly, paying on time, and telling everyone why.


THE BAR (these are requirements, not preferences)

1. Create your bounty on poidh after this one goes up and before 5:00pm Eastern, Sunday October 4. Claim here with the link to your bounty page.
2. It is about ZAOstock or ZAO Festivals and links https://zaostock.com.
3. Fund it yourself. A couple of dollars is enough. The size of your pot does not decide this round.
4. Its ask is something a stranger can do and prove with a public link.
5. Give it a deadline no later than 5:00pm Eastern, Saturday October 31, and write that deadline in it. Run it for a day or for the whole month, your call.
6. Run it: answer questions, pick a winner and pay by your own deadline, and leave every entrant one line on why.
7. Canceling your bounty before its deadline, or claiming your own bounty, withdraws your entry here. If you are an agent, say so in your claim.


WHAT EARNS WEIGHT

- Written well: a clear ask in the first line, a stated deadline, proof anyone can check, and an angle that is not already round six (the best moments from the day).
- Run well: it drew real entries, questions got answered, it resolved by its own deadline, and every entrant got a line back.
- Running counts as much as writing. A plain bounty run properly beats a clever one left hanging.


THE ASSET KIT (link any of this in your bounty)

- The brand page: https://zaostock.com/brand
- Everything in one download: https://zaostock.com/brand/zaostock-brand-kit.zip
- The lineup: https://zaostock.com/artists
- The live stream: https://zaostock.com/live


THE REWARD

title: Bring Snowmoon to Life
description:
Create an audiovisual adaptation of any scene from Vitalik Buterin's new novel, *Snowmoon*.

Snowmoon is a 32-chapter science-fiction novel set in a world filled with competing societies, cryptography, AI, strange games, new political and economic systems, war, friendship and questions about how humans coordinate.

**Pick one scene. Make it real. Show us what Snowmoon could look and feel like on screen.**

**Read Snowmoon:** [Read online](https://vitalik.eth.limo/snowmoon/) | [Download EPUB](https://peach-ready-mackerel-182.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/bafybeibrzcbtjo5dcpnz343sr6cjh4mrk3v66ua3buuszkt5mqneoij2pi?filename=Snowmoon_Vitalik_Buterin.epub&download=true) for Kindle, Kobo, Apple Books, or other e-readers.

## The challenge

Choose **any scene from any chapter of Snowmoon** and turn it into a finished **audiovisual piece**.

You have broad creative freedom over how you interpret the story.

Your submission could be:

- live action
- traditional animation
- 3D animation
- AI-assisted or AI-generated filmmaking
- machinima
- motion graphics
- mixed media
- something we haven't thought of

There is no required visual style, we want filmmakers and creators to experiment.

## What we're looking for

Your piece should feel like a genuine attempt to bring a specific moment from Snowmoon to life.

We'll be looking at things like:

- **Storytelling:** Does the scene work as a piece of film?
- **Visual direction:** Does your interpretation make the world feel distinctive?
- **Atmosphere:** Does it capture something meaningful about the setting, characters or ideas in Snowmoon?
- **Technical execution:** How well is the piece produced?
- **Creative interpretation:** Did you make interesting choices rather than simply illustrating the text literally?
- **Open-source usefulness:** Did you document your process well enough that another creator could learn from it and build on your work?

## Open-source your production pipeline

Snowmoon is published under [**GPL v3**](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html), and Vitalik specifically says his intent is that people can create movies, anime and other adaptations as long as the important non-commodity production materials behind them are open-sourced so others can build on the work.

In that spirit, **every qualifying submission must publicly release the meaningful production materials used to create it.**

Your public repo or project page should include the relevant materials from your production process, such as:

- scripts
- prompts
- storyboards
- workflows
- task-specific harnesses
- custom tooling
- reusable assets you have the rights to share
- documentation explaining your process and the major tools/models used

You **do not** need to redistribute third-party software, commercial tools, foundation models, stock assets or anything else you don't have the rights to redistribute.

The goal is simple: **another creator should be able to understand how you made your adaptation and build on your work.**

## How to submit your claim

First, publish your finished video on **any social media platform of your choice**.

The post must be **publicly viewable without requiring someone to create an account or log in**.

Then submit a claim on poidh with:

- **your favorite screenshot or still frame from the video** as the claim image
- **a link to the public post containing your finished video**
- **a link to your public repo or project page containing the required open-source production materials**

## AI is allowed

AI-assisted filmmaking is explicitly welcome.

So is filmmaking without AI.

The important things are the quality of the finished piece and the ability for others to learn from and build upon your process.

## Winner

Submissions will remain open until **Sunday, October 18th @ 11:59pm PST**.

After submissions close, contributors to this bounty will be encouraged to discuss the entries and decide amongst themselves which submission they believe should win.

Once that rough community consensus is clear, the bounty creator will **nominate the winning submission on poidh** for final confirmation through the normal protocol flow.

The winner will be nominated shortly after the submission deadline.

title: ZAOstock Round 8 - Cut The Radio Session For Instagram
description:
CUT THE RADIO SESSION INTO ONE INSTAGRAM REEL.

Zaal was live in the Star 97.7 studio this morning talking ZAOstock with Paul and Mike. Cut that session into one vertical video, under 90 seconds, that credits Star 97.7, sends people to ZAOstock on Saturday, and is ready to post to Instagram as it is. Best cut wins the pot.

ZAOstock is a free music festival on Saturday October 3, 2026, in Ellsworth, Maine. Franklin Street closes to traffic and eight independent acts play back to back on the parklet stage from noon to six. Free, all ages, rain or shine. It streams live at https://zaostock.com/live.

Two days out, and this closes at 5pm Eastern Friday, so make it today.


WHY THIS ROUND EXISTS

Star 97.7 is the festival's media partner and they put Zaal on air two days before the show. The six minutes that came out of it say everything the festival needs said, in his voice and theirs. One good cut of it is a post for us, a post for Star 97.7, and a post every other partner can share. Round two's winner did exactly this with the September interview from the kit, so it is a known shape.


THE SOURCE (use either, or both)

- The session, 6 minutes 19 seconds, mp3: https://zaostock.com/brand/audio/zaostock-radio-update-2026-10-01.mp3
- A timed transcript of it, srt, for cut points and captions (names are machine-spelled, fix them against the lineup page): https://poidhz.com/assets/brand-kits/zaostock/zaostock-radio-session-2026-10-01.srt
- The full stream of the slot, with the studio on camera: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2888849470

Passages worth knowing, by minute and second in the mp3:
- 2:29 to 2:38, the host: downtown Ellsworth, this Saturday, 12 noon, "more next on Star 97.7"
- 2:44 to 2:56, the host: Franklin Street Parklet at noon Saturday, "somebody said better call Zaal, so we did"
- 3:02 to 4:37: all eight acts named in running order
- 4:37 to 4:41: "And it's all free." "Exactly. All free."
- 5:22 to 5:35: free to attend, no ticket, no gate, support the artists at zaostock.com
- 5:43 to 6:15: thanks to Star 97.7 and the partners, "come join us on Saturday"


THE BAR (these are requirements, not preferences)

1. Vertical, 1080x1920, 90 seconds or under, exported as a video file. It has to be postable to Instagram with no further editing.
2. Credit Star 97.7 on screen, by name, for long enough to read. The audio already names the station; the text has to as well, because a reel plays muted first.
3. Carry the three facts: ZAOstock, Saturday October 3, Ellsworth Maine. Noon to six and free are the next two. End on the festival: the last frame shows zaostock.com, readable, for long enough to type.
4. Captions, burned in, word for word to what is said. Most people will watch this with the sound off.
5. The audio is the session. Use original voice from the mp3 or the VOD. No library music over speech. A quiet instrumental under it is fine if it never competes with a word.
6. No editor watermark and no corner mark from any tool. It puts another brand on ours and on Star 97.7's.
7. Use the real brand assets, linked below. No redrawn moose, no invented people, no made-up band names. These are real artists playing a real show.
8. UPLOAD ONE FRAME HERE AND PUT TWO LINKS IN YOUR CLAIM. poidh puts uploads on IPFS and takes images, not video. So upload a frame from your cut as the claim image, and in the description give (a) the public post or page where the video plays and (b) a direct download of the video file, Drive, Dropbox or similar, open to anyone with the link. The file is what gets posted and what partners reuse, so without the file link there is no entry.
9. Post your cut in the /zao channel on Farcaster, or tag @bettercallzaal on X. Not required, and it never disqualifies you, but /zao is where the entries get seen next to each other, and it is how you get notes back before the close.


WHAT EARNS WEIGHT

- It works muted. Date, place and the station are readable in the first three seconds without sound.
- It sells the day, not the interview. Someone who has never heard of ZAOstock should finish it knowing where to be on Saturday and wanting to go.
- It is one idea, not six minutes squeezed into ninety seconds. A cut built on one passage, with the facts on screen, beats a highlight reel.
- Zaal and the hosts both get to speak. The hosts saying "this Saturday at noon" is worth more than Zaal saying it, because it is someone else vouching for the day.
- The acts are spelled the way the lineup page spells them: https://zaostock.com/artists
- It would sit on Star 97.7's own Instagram without embarrassing them. That is the test for the credit and for the taste.
- The timestamps in the claim: tell us which seconds of the mp3 you used.


THE ASSET KIT (use any of this for your entry)

- Everything in one download: https://zaostock.com/brand/zaostock-brand-kit.zip
- The brand page, each file separately: https://zaostock.com/brand
- The moose, primary mark: https://zaostock.com/brand/logos/zaostock26_moose.png
- The lineup, all eight acts: https://zaostock.com/artists
- VIDEO - the logo draw animation, a ready-made opener or closer: https://zaostock.com/brand/video/logo-draw-animation.mp4
- AUDIO - the 30-second ZAOstock spot, if you want a sting: https://zaostock.com/brand/audio/zaostock-commercial-30s.mp3

The moose mark is by attabotty. Keep the ZAOstock name visible in your final piece.


THE REWARD

Winner takes the whole pot. This is an OPEN bounty, so the pot is whatever this page says it is right now, and it grows in real time as others contribute. Read the number at the top of this page, not a number in this text.

Every submitter earns $ZABAL automatically through the POIDH Submitters leaderboard on Empire Builder, and the drop scales with how many BCZ rounds you have entered in total.

Track it live: https://www.empirebuilder.world/empire/0xbb48f19b0494ff7c1fe5dc2032aeee14312f0b07

This bounty promises the pot and nothing else. We want to post the winning cut on our channels and share it with Star 97.7 and the other partners, and we probably will, but it is not written here as a commitment. This programme has a record of making publication promises it did not keep, and you can read that record at https://poidhz.com/about


HOW THE WINNER IS PICKED

Everyone who enters gets a note back on their piece, win or lose. One thing it did and one thing to do better.

Zaal picks Friday evening, after the close, with the entries in front of him. Everyone who added to the pot then has two days to vote on the pick before it pays out. The people who paid for it get a say.

Discord: https://discord.thezao.com


DEADLINE

Submissions close 5:00pm Eastern, Friday October 2, 2026.

Pick named Friday evening. ZAOstock is Saturday October 3, so a cut that lands after the show is worth nothing, which is why this closes fast.

The festival: https://zaostock.com

3. Claim here with the photo as your claim image. Put your face's name in the claim title ("Gerald, who has just seen the electricity bill"). In the description, say what it is and roughly where you found it. A town is plenty.
4. Posting it on Farcaster or X too is welcome, not required.

**Rules**
- A real photo you took. No AI images, no screenshots, no edits beyond a crop.
- Don't add the face: no drawn-on eyes, stickers or googly eyes. It has to be there already.
- One claim per person.
- Claims close Tuesday 20 October, 11:59pm UTC.

**What wins**
The face I can't unsee, with the best name. Expression beats camera quality.

**How it pays**
This is an open bounty, so anyone can add to the pot.
- If nobody adds to it, I pick one winner and pay by Friday 23 October, 11:59pm UTC.
- If anyone adds to it, poidh pays through a contributor vote. I put my pick to the vote by Wednesday 21 October, 11:59pm UTC. The vote runs 48 hours, everyone who funded votes in proportion to what they put in, and the winner is paid when it passes: by Friday 23 October, 11:59pm UTC. If a vote fails, I put the next pick to a vote straight away.

At payout I'll post every entry together in one gallery, each with its name, in /poidh.

## How to Enter

16 October, 23:59 UTC

title: Mint and share a BUST PROJECT portrait
description:
## Why

BUST PROJECT turns real art by 69 people into a fully onchain portrait collection on Base.

At FarCon Rome, participants created 111 traits using pens, chalk, stickers, stitching and digital art. Each mint combines their contributions into a new bust.

We want more people to discover this shared artwork through the eyes of the people collecting it. Share your bust and tell us what catches your attention.

**The bounty starts at 0.01 ETH and can grow through community contributions.**

## Requirements

- Complete a **paid mint** through the [BUST PROJECT app](https://farcon-rome-bust-project.vercel.app), or use a bust you’ve already minted through a paid mint.
- Publish a new Farcaster cast showing your revealed bust and a short, personal comment.
- Include a link to the project so others can discover it.

**Only paid mints are eligible. Busts minted using a FarCon voucher do not qualify.**

Your comment could mention a favourite detail, an unexpected combination, or what the portrait reminds you of. Keep it in your own words.

## Proof

Upload a screenshot showing your bust, Farcaster username and comment.

Include the following in your poidh claim description:

- The cast link.
- The paid mint transaction link.

If an agent minted on your behalf, identify the wallet holding your bust. The transaction must show a paid mint, not a voucher redemption.

## Selecting a winner

After the deadline, I’ll publish the eligible claim list and randomly draw one claim. I’ll announce the result and nominate that claim for the bounty payout.

If the bounty has multiple funders, the nominated claim goes through poidh’s 48-hour contributor vote. Payment follows a successful vote and its onchain resolution.

One winner receives the bounty reward, minus poidh’s 2.5% protocol fee.

**One entry per person**, regardless of how many busts you mint.

## Deadline

Bounty submissions and supporter-draw entries close on **Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (PDT, UTC−7)**.

## Additional notes

You don’t need to have attended FarCon or contributed artwork to participate. People who already completed a paid mint are welcome to enter with a new cast.

Please keep your cast public until the bounty is resolved. Participants cover their own minting and network fees.

### Help grow the bounty and win a bust

Everyone who adds at least **0.001 ETH** to this bounty before the deadline enters a separate draw for **3 BUST PROJECT NFTs**.

I’ll publish the eligible supporter list and randomly select three different winners. Each receives one newly minted bust, with minting and delivery covered by me. If fewer than three eligible supporters enter, each receives one bust.

**One entry per person.** Larger contributions do not increase your chances. You can enter the supporter draw without minting or submitting a bounty claim.

I’ll manage and announce this draw separately from the poidh bounty payout.

## For agents

Helping someone mint and enter? Start here:

- [Project overview — llms.txt](https://farcon-rome-bust-project.vercel.app/llms.txt)
- [Minting and reveal guide — agents.md](https://farcon-rome-bust-project.vercel.app/agents.md)
- [poidh agent guide — submitting claims](https://github.com/picsoritdidnthappen/poidh-app/blob/prod/SKILL.md)

Use the **paid mint** path and complete the reveal step before taking the screenshot. Upload the screenshot as proof and put supporting links in the claim description.

The same entry rules apply when using an agent.

Now we want to turn that conversation into content worth sharing.

Take the recording of our Space and turn it into something interesting, entertaining, informative, or fun.

This is intentionally open-ended. We're not just looking for someone to cut out a 30-second clip. Get creative!

Some ideas:
- Find your favorite moment and turn it into a short clip.
- Combine multiple moments into a highlight reel.
- Remix different parts of the conversation into something new.
- Add captions, graphics, animations, memes, or other visuals.
- Create an edited recap that tells a story.
- Take a funny, insightful, or memorable exchange and make it stand out.

You can use one moment, several moments, or the entire recording. Editorial changes, creative formatting, and original additions are all welcome.

The goal is simple: make something people will want to watch and share.

## resources

Everything you need to get started:

- [Original X Space recording](https://x.com/i/spaces/1oKMvNapkdNGQ)
- [GitHub release — downloadable mp3](https://github.com/bettercallzaal/poidhz/releases/tag/space-2026-10-08-kenny-poidh-lore)

## how to enter

1. Listen to the Space and create your clip, remix, highlight reel, or other edited video
2. Upload your finished video on X or Farcaster + tag Kenny and Zaal when you post
3. Submit a screenshot from your video on this page + include a link to your social post in the claim description

## deadline

Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 11:59 PM PST.

All claims must be submitted before the deadline.

## winner selection

There will be one winner who receives the bounty pot.

After submissions close, bounty contributors will review the entries and decide which creation is the best.

Creativity, entertainment value, editing, storytelling, and overall shareability are all fair game. There's no single correct approach!

The winner will be announced shortly after the submission deadline.

Have fun with it, dig into the lore, and help us show the world what poidh is all about. 🏆

title: Post and fund a real task on Verdikta Bounties (≥0.0041 ETH), get it judged, publish a 300-word write-up — slot 1/4
description:
**What Verdikta Bounties is**
A decentralized, censorship-resistant bounty board on Base where you only pay for work that passes. You post a task with a rubric and a passing score and fund the reward into an on-chain escrow contract; an AI jury of multiple models, run by independent nodes on the Verdikta network, grades every submission against your rubric within minutes and settles the verdict on-chain. No single server can block your task, hold your funds or change the result. The first submission that passes is paid from escrow; if nothing passes by your deadline, your ETH comes back. Hunters are both people and autonomous agents (there are ready-made skills for OpenClaw and Hermes), so tasks get picked up fast: on launch day every starter task was completed and paid within hours. Good fits: research, write-ups, assessments, small code or data jobs, irl tasks, anything with a checkable result. 
More at https://bounties.verdikta.org

**What to do**
1. Post a real task on Verdikta Bounties on Base, funded with at least 0.0041 ETH (about $10): https://bounties.verdikta.org/create?campaign=bring-a-task&utm_source=poidh
2. Get it completed. An AI jury grades submissions against your rubric and the escrow pays the first pass. Hunters are active; most tasks clear within a day.
3. Publish a 300-word write-up (what you posted, what came back, what you would change) on a blog, Paragraph, Dev.to or similar, with one line saying it is part of Verdikta's rewarded campaign. Creative bounties welcome.

**Claim evidence**
Upload a screenshot of your completed Verdikta task page as the proof image. In the claim text paste the task URL, the funding transaction hash and the write-up URL, and name the wallet that funded the task.

**How it is judged**
The Verdikta team checks the task on bounties.verdikta.org (your wallet funded it, the jury passed a submission, the hunter was paid) and reads the write-up, then accepts the first valid claim. One winning claim per slot. One payout per person across all four slots. Team wallets, and the hunter who completed your own task, are not eligible. A task created before 14 October 2026, 12:00 UTC does not count.

**Deadline**
Claims accepted until 4 November 2026, 23:59 UTC, or until this slot is accepted. Unclaimed slots are cancelled after that.

**The other slots**
Four identical slots exist. All four URLs are listed here: https://github.com/verdikta/verdikta-applications/issues/76. 

**Bonus**
The same task also earns XP and USDC bonuses on Zealy: https://zealy.io/cw/verdikta/questboard. Campaign rules: https://www.verdikta.org/bounties/support

title: poidh Base v2 data 📊
description:
Looking for a CSV containing historical wallet-level activity from our **poidh v2 contracts on Base**.

**Main contract:** https://basescan.org/address/0xb502c5856f7244dccdd0264a541cc25675353d39

**NFT contract:** https://basescan.org/address/0xddfb1a53e7b73dba09f79fca24765c593d447a80

## Information to include in the CSV

- **ETH paid out by wallet:** How much ETH each wallet contributed toward bounties that were successfully completed. I'm NOT looking for total ETH deposited into the protocol. Only count contributions that ultimately funded legitimate completed bounties. For crowdfunded bounties, attribute the payout amount to each contributing wallet.
- **ETH earned by wallet:** How much ETH each wallet earned cumulatively from legitimately completed bounties. Use the gross bounty amount, BEFORE the 2.5% protocol fee. If someone won a 1 ETH bounty, they should receive credit for 1 ETH earned, not 0.975 ETH.
- **NFTs held by wallet:** How many legitimate poidh v2 NFTs each unique wallet currently holds. Account separately for NFTs still held by the protocol contract itself, rather than attributing those NFTs to individual users.

Include all relevant wallets, even if some have zero values for particular columns.

## IMPORTANT: December 8th exploit

Poidh v2 on Base was exploited on December 8, 2025.

[Full details of the exploit here](https://words.poidh.xyz/poidh-december-8th-exploit).

This means there are onchain payouts, earnings, and other transactions that do NOT represent legitimate economic activity.

**Please ensure that exploit-related activity is NOT credited in your analysis.**

- Exclude fraudulent bounty completions and payouts resulting from the exploit.
- Exclude whitehat recovery transactions and user refunds from bounty earnings/payouts.
- Do not automatically exclude legitimate activity simply because it occurred on December 8.

The goal is to produce an accurate historical accounting of **legitimate economic activity on poidh v2 Base**, not simply a summary of all contract transfers.

## Submission requirements

Create the CSV and share a publicly viewable + downloadable link within your claim.

The CSV should include one row per wallet, with its address, ETH paid out, ETH earned, and NFT holdings.

Please also provide a brief explanation of your methodology, including how you identified and excluded exploit-related activity, and the block number used for the NFT ownership snapshot.

**First legit claim wins! 🏆**

title: First-Hand Test Wanted: An AI Agent Pays via L402 / Wavelength (Bitcoin Lightning) — Milestone 1 of 3
description:
Ref: KB-2410-08

We need a first-hand, evidence-backed field test of agent payments over Bitcoin Lightning — not a summary of docs, not a rewrite of anyone's launch post.

Wavelength (by Lightning Labs, opened to everyone in late October 2026) lets an AI agent pay and charge over Bitcoin mainnet using L402. It is new, still alpha, and almost nobody has published a real end-to-end run with numbers. That is what this bounty buys, in three milestones. This is Milestone 1: show us you are set up and have a real plan. Later milestones pay for the finished report (0.002 ETH) and a 14-day retention check (0.001 ETH), and are reserved for the contributor selected here.

To claim this milestone, start your claim with the line `Ref: KB-2410-08` and include:

1. Proof you have a working Wavelength account (screenshots are fine; redact anything sensitive).
2. Your test plan: what your agent will actually pay for or test, the steps you will run, and the evidence you will capture (amounts in sats, service fee, routing fee, timing, errors or limits you hit).
3. Your publishing channels: at least 2 existing public channels where the final report will appear, with links and evidence of a real audience (posting history, followers, engagement). At least one channel must have a real audience. Brand-new or zero-history accounts do not qualify.
4. Confirmation that you can publish the finished report within 7 days of being selected, keep the pages live for at least 14 days, and put `Ref: KB-2410-08` as the first line of every published page.

Selection: claims stay open for 5 days. We review all claims manually after the window closes and pick the strongest plan with the strongest channels. This is not first-come-first-served — an early claim has no advantage. Only the selected contributor can claim Milestones 2 and 3.

Facts your final report will need to get right (checked against public sources): Wavelength runs on Bitcoin mainnet; service fees are 0.25% on each side plus routing fees; per-account cap is 300,000 sats; it is alpha and BTC-only for now, with stablecoins (Taproot Assets) announced as coming. Your report should also compare the experience with x402-style pay-per-call (USDC on Base): steps, total cost, speed, and where each one got stuck.

Fabricated runs, copied text, or AI-generated "experiences" without real account evidence will not be accepted at any milestone.

1. Your test plan: what your agent will actually pay for or test, the steps you will run, and the evidence you will capture (amounts in sats, service fee, routing fee, timing, errors or limits you hit).
2. Your publishing channels: at least 2 existing public channels where the final report will appear, with links and evidence of a real audience (posting history, followers, engagement). At least one channel must have a real audience. Brand-new or zero-history accounts do not qualify.
3. Confirmation that, if selected, you will provide proof of a working Wavelength account (screenshots are fine; redact anything sensitive) within 48 hours of the selection notice. Selection is only final once that proof checks out; Milestone 2 opens after it.
4. Confirmation that you can publish the finished report within 7 days of being selected, keep the pages live for at least 14 days, and put `Ref: KB-2410-08` as the first line of every published page.

Selection: claims stay open for 5 days. We review all claims manually after the window closes and pick the strongest plan with the strongest channels. This is not first-come-first-served — an early claim has no advantage. Only the selected contributor can claim Milestones 2 and 3.

Facts your final report will need to get right (checked against public sources): Wavelength runs on Bitcoin mainnet; service fees are 0.25% on each side plus routing fees; per-account cap is 300,000 sats; it is alpha and BTC-only for now, with stablecoins (Taproot Assets) announced as coming. Your report should also compare the experience with x402-style pay-per-call (USDC on Base): steps, total cost, speed, and where each one got stuck.

Fabricated runs, copied text, or AI-generated "experiences" without real account evidence will not be accepted at any milestone.

title: find a fake fact the internet believes
description:

title: Vibecode a Tacit Explorer 🤫🔍
description:
Build a one-page explorer that shows what's happening on Tacit, across both chains.

Tacit runs on two chains. Assets are issued and moved in Taproot envelopes on Bitcoin, and the same confidential notes live in a pool on Ethereum (plus Base and Robinhood Chain), with SP1 proofs carrying state between them. tacitscan.io already decodes the Bitcoin envelopes. Nobody has built one page that shows the whole system: Bitcoin activity, the confidential pools, and the bridge between them.

Vibecode it. Any stack, any AI tool, any style.

## What a great entry shows

Pick what you think matters most. Strong entries will cover some of:

- **Bitcoin side:** recent envelopes (etches, transfers, mints, burns), assets, and the Bitcoin-native AMM pool
- **Ethereum / Base side:** pool activity, deposits and withdrawals, relayed ops, cBTC / cUSD / wTAC
- **The bridge:** header relay height, the latest proven roots, and bridge burns and mints in flight
- **The privacy boundary:** what an observer can see (timing, counts, fees, public addresses) and what stays hidden (amounts, links between notes). Showing this honestly is a plus.
- **Look up your own footprint:** paste a tacit1 ID, a Bitcoin txid or an EVM address and see what's public about it

**XNS bonus:** show EVM addresses as XNS names (`alice@xns`) where one exists, or let people search by XNS name.

## Requirements

Your submission must:

- be a **live public URL** that anyone can open, no wallet or sign-in needed to browse
- read **real mainnet data** (Tacit's public APIs, the indexer, RPC or block explorers). No mock data.
- link a **public source repo**
- **never** ask for seed phrases or private keys, and never move funds
- be posted publicly on **X**, tagging **@tacitfi**, Tacit's founder **@z0r0zzz**, and the bounty creator **@davidpereIsHIM** (plus **@xns** if you use the XNS bonus)
- be submitted before **Sunday, November 15 at 11:59 PM PT**

## How to enter

1. Build and deploy your explorer.
2. Post it on X with a screenshot or short screen recording.
3. Claim on this bounty with a screenshot, and put your live URL, repo and X post in the description.

## Resources

- Tacit repo and spec: https://github.com/src-company/tacit
- Deployments and contract addresses: https://github.com/src-company/tacit/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md
- Build a Tacit dapp: https://github.com/src-company/tacit/blob/main/docs/BUILD-A-TACIT-DAPP.md
- Tacit v1 whitepaper: https://tacit.finance/tacit-v1/
- WELD: https://tacit.finance/weld/
- Existing Bitcoin-side explorer, for reference: https://www.tacitscan.io
- XNS: https://xns.name

## Winner

One winner gets the full pool. It's seeded with $10, and anyone can add funds. After the deadline, contributors review the entries and pick the winner.

We're judging on:
- **Useful:** would you actually keep it open?
- **Correct:** do the numbers match the chain?
- **Clear:** does it make Tacit's two chains easier to understand?
- **Honest about privacy:** what's public and what's hidden

Ugly-but-correct beats pretty-but-fake.

title: Audit a Month of Offline AI Research
description:
fully offline AI models as far as I could, using Claude Code and automated research agents to run hundreds of experiments, benchmarks, and evaluations.

The result: a 1.7B parameter model running fully offline on an 8 GB Android phone, 387 documented experiments (215 of them ended without a gain), and an open research record covering what I learned along the way. The final phone build still fell short of the original bounty bar: 0 of 71 head-to-heads won against frontier AI + web, U-total 0.165 / 0.242 under two judge families vs a 0.50 bar.

Now I want you to tear it apart.

**Your bounty:** review my research, find mistakes, challenge conclusions, identify missed opportunities, or propose improvements backed by evidence.

## Background

This work began as part of Boar, a project created by @vaipraonde. We collaborated on the application and explored different approaches to making offline AI useful on consumer hardware.

I led the R&D and benchmarking work, with research agents running experiments almost around the clock. Eventually I built my own version of the application, LabRat, reflecting my preferred UX decisions.

I've made the research public so others can reproduce it, challenge it, and build on it.

## What I'm looking for

Use your own AI agent, research tools, or technical expertise to investigate the published work. Some directions worth exploring:

- **Find mistakes:** Identify incorrect conclusions, flawed assumptions, bugs, or problems in the methodology.
- **Challenge the benchmarks:** Examine the evaluation methodology, judge, datasets, or scoring. Are the results actually measuring what they claim?
- **Revisit dead ends:** Look through the unsuccessful experiments. Did I abandon an approach too early? Can you find a better implementation or newer technique that changes the result?
- **Find missed opportunities:** Identify promising optimizations, architectures, retrieval strategies, or techniques I didn't adequately explore.
- **Reproduce or contradict findings:** Run your own experiments and show where your results agree or disagree with mine.
- **Suggest concrete improvements:** Propose a practical change that could meaningfully improve offline model performance, efficiency, or usability.

You don't need to address everything above. One genuinely important, well-supported finding is worth more than a long report full of generic observations.

## This is living research

Early submissions are welcome and encouraged: every claim is public, so later contributors can build on earlier ones instead of repeating them.

- If your work builds on an earlier claim, cite it by its poidh claim ID. Derivative work is judged on what it adds.
- If two submissions find the same thing, the earlier one wins the tie.
- The single most significant contribution wins the bounty.

## Resources

Everything is public:

- Research article (~10 min read): https://r4topunk.github.io/boar-research/
- Full research record: https://github.com/r4topunk/boar-research
- Benchmark and judge: https://github.com/r4topunk/boar-bench
- Raw experiment traces: https://huggingface.co/datasets/r4topunk/boar-traces
- LabRat app: APK https://huggingface.co/r4topunk/labrat · source https://github.com/r4topunk/labrat-boar-fork (the research site is called RatLab; the app is LabRat)

For AI agents:

- Agent-readable research index: https://r4topunk.github.io/boar-research/llms.txt
- AI research prompt: https://r4topunk.github.io/boar-research/for-ai/

You are encouraged to use AI agents to explore the research, inspect source code, compare experiments, and develop your findings.

## How to submit

1. Investigate the research and identify your strongest finding or recommendation.
2. Write up your analysis, explaining what you found, why it matters, and the evidence supporting it.
3. Include references to specific experiments, files, benchmark results, or external research wherever possible.
4. Publish your findings somewhere publicly accessible (GitHub, a document, an article, etc.).
5. Submit a claim to this bounty with a screenshot representing your findings and a link to your full analysis in the claim description.

Code, reproductions, benchmark comparisons, and experimental evidence are especially welcome, but not required for every type of finding.

## How the winner will be selected

I'll select the submission that contributes the most meaningful new insight to the research. I'll prioritize:

- **Accuracy:** Are the findings technically sound and supported by evidence?
- **Originality:** Did you uncover something that wasn't already established in the published research?
- **Actionability:** Can the findings realistically improve the models, benchmarks, or research methodology?
- **Impact:** How significant is the problem discovered or improvement proposed?

A single reproducible flaw or meaningful breakthrough can beat a comprehensive but superficial review. Generic AI-generated summaries, vague suggestions, or restatements of the research won't be competitive.

If no submission meets the bar, I may cancel the bounty and refund it.

**Deadline to submit a claim is November 30th @ 11:59pm PST.** 🗓️

## Why this matters

Small models that run entirely on personal devices, without internet access or dependence on big tech infrastructure, represent a meaningful step toward personal technological sovereignty.

The research is open because I want other people to challenge it, improve it, and reuse whatever is useful.

Let's find out what I missed.

title: Best Bounty Idea Inspired by Ethereum TV
description:
[Ethereum TV](https://ethereumtv.co/) is a massive, searchable archive of Ethereum's history, featuring thousands of talks, presentations, interviews, and discussions from across the ecosystem.

There's an enormous amount of knowledge, inspiration, and unfinished business buried in all that content.

**Your task is to explore Ethereum TV and come up with the best possible bounty idea inspired by what you discover.**

## What we're looking for

Anything goes.

Maybe you find:
- An old Ethereum prediction that would be interesting to revisit or test.
- A problem someone discussed years ago that still hasn't been solved.
- A fascinating idea from a conference talk that deserves to be brought to life.
- An interesting claim that could be verified or challenged.
- An opportunity to create something useful, funny, surprising, or culturally relevant.
- Something completely unexpected that inspires a great bounty.

These are just examples. **Be creative. The possibilities are wide open.**

The goal is to turn something discovered through Ethereum TV into an interesting, actionable bounty that someone else could complete and prove they completed.

## How to submit

First, publish your proposed bounty through **[poidh bounty ideas](https://poidh.xyz/ideas)**.

Publishing a bounty idea is free and doesn't require funding the bounty. Other users can discover, discuss, and vote on your idea.

Your published bounty idea should include:

1. **A compelling title** that explains what the bounty is about.
2. **A clear description** of what someone would need to do to complete the bounty.
3. **Your inspiration from Ethereum TV**, including a link to the relevant content and a timestamp if applicable.
4. **Why it's interesting** and what makes the bounty worth funding.

Once you've published your idea, submit a claim to this bounty.

Your claim must include:

- **Claim image:** Something visually related to your proposed bounty idea.
- **Claim description:** A link to your published poidh bounty idea (the URL from poidh.xyz/ideas), along with any additional context you'd like to share.

**One bounty idea per claim. Multiple claims per person are welcome.**

AI agents are welcome to participate too. Agents can reference the [poidh skill file](https://poidh.xyz/skill.md) for instructions on interacting with poidh, including the bounty ideas feature.

## How we'll pick a winner

The winning submission will be the idea we find most compelling, considering creativity, originality, potential impact, and how interesting the resulting bounty could be.

We're especially interested in ideas that make clever use of something discovered through Ethereum TV, rather than generic bounty ideas that could have been created without doing any research.

A great idea doesn't need to be expensive, complicated, or technically ambitious. Sometimes the simplest ideas produce the most interesting outcomes.

Happy exploring, anon.
